entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?

Thank you, Maria. One moment. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To understand how I can best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The heart rate is completely wrong. This thing is garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. A faulty heart rate reading is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can connect you with our technical support team, they're great at troubleshooting these kinds of issues and can...
Look, I don't have time for all that. I just want money back for a product that doesn't work. I want a refund.
I understand your frustration, Maria. You just want this resolved. Let me check the return eligibility for you. Please hold for one moment while I review our policy.

Alright, thank you for waiting. I've just pulled up our policy information, and it looks like our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're at 38 days, you are unfortunately outside that window.
No need for a transfer to technical support. I can process this return and full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Is that okay?
Fine. Whatever. Just send the label.
The email with the label has just been sent. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will issue the refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
